description: RaidRunner helps Twitch streamers run and join raid trains — back-to-back stream relay events. From ChatGPT you can see the events you perform in or organize, your upcoming claimed slots, and full event lineups; discover public events to join; and claim, release, or waitlist slots and manage slot-trade requests. Everything is scoped to your own connected RaidRunner account.
